facts.fact: The Minister of Posts and Telecommunications told the National Assembly that Cameroon adopted Loi n°2024/017 of 23 December 2024 on personal data protection, setting principles, controller obligations and data subject rights; no commencement is stated (document dated 2025-04-08).
facts.system: Loi n°2024/017 relative à la protection des données à caractère personnel

note: carried from dataprotectionlaw; no document opened
